**1.006: no more half-words where live dictation is split.**

- **Whole words at the joins:** when you dictate with text appearing as you go, each piece after a pause is decoded with the end of the one before it. The first word of a piece sometimes lost its start ("ividual" for "individual"); it now comes out whole. The same fix is in Android 1.005.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb and a portable Windows zip. Not yet tested on Windows hardware. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
